aesthetic: Neue Sachlichkeit Press — Swiss grid rigor on a warm press-white ground: carbon typography, geometric silence, and a single vermillion bar as the deck's sole chromatic event.
chromaticArc: Slides 1–3 open on pure Warm Press White; slides 4–6 shift to Laid Paper with Carbon Black section dividers at slides 3 and 7; Bauhaus Vermillion fires once at slide 5 as a structural interrupt; slides 8–10 resolve back to White.
gridStrategy: Each slide rotates through five archetypes — wide-statement (col 0 span 58), right-offset (col 30 span 28), sidebar-content (col 0 span 18 / body col 22 span 36), centred column (col 12 span 36), stacked-narrow (col 4 span 24) — with no two consecutive slides sharing the same archetype.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on slides 6 and 9 — body-heavy analytical pages where editorial warmth counterpoints the geometric grid, tracking set to 0.04em.

accentStrategy: Thin horizontal rules (type 'line', 1–2px) divide title from body zones on 40% of slides; the single bold vertical bar (col 0 span 1, full row height) in Bauhaus Vermillion appears only on slide 5 as the deck's sole chromatic punctuation.
